title: Check-in record (contract 10)
description: A check-in: a standing duty the hub's scheduler evaluates for free and fires as one hub-queued message to Home's chat (contract 10, C-10.14c, amendment A-10.4; R37 H4 (a), H8 (a), H10 (b), H11 (a)). The root is the stored record as ListCheckIns and SetCheckIn answer it ($defs/record); $defs/record_input is the record less its hub-set fields, as SetCheckIn takes it (10-hub-request.json $defs/params_SetCheckIn). Every object is closed: the hub refuses an unknown key, a brakes field (min_interval_s, max_fires_per_day, active_after, active_until: none exists, R37 H10 (b)) or set_by in a body as bad_request with field, on create and edit alike. The schema checks shape; the hub checks that a zone names a zone of its tz database, that a cron expression means a schedule, that a dashboard exists, that a condition's trigger is stored as events_count on an edit, and the second confirm of a Home-authored record (C-10.14c). Times are RFC 3339 (a check-in is read in a zone), where older 10 results carry epoch ms. Retention: A-11.3's check-in row.

checkin_id.description: A check-in record's id: the prefix cki_ under 03 section 2's grammar (lowercase Crockford, 26 characters), listed by A-03.7 among the prefixes other contracts mint. Minted by the hub.

zone.description: An IANA time zone name (America/New_York, Europe/Lisbon, UTC). The schema checks the shape; the hub checks that its tz database holds the zone and answers bad_request with field otherwise.

cron_expr.description: A five-field cron expression (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week), fields separated by one space, for example '0 9 * * 1-5'. The schema checks five fields of cron characters; the hub checks the meaning (ranges, steps, names) and answers bad_request with field when it describes no schedule.

duration.description: An ISO 8601 duration of days, hours, minutes and seconds (PT15M, PT6H, P1D): a window back from the time of the read.

trigger.description: Exactly one trigger (R37 H4 (a), H8 (a)): cron in a zone, a fixed interval, one instant, or a typed EventsDB count polled by the hub. 'CI fails or the deploy is late' is two records. The floor on every polled or repeated trigger is 300 s; no change-feed watcher exists (H8 (a)).

zone.description: The zone the expression is evaluated in.

oneOf.description: Fires at each time the expression names, in its zone.

every_s.description: Seconds between fires, at least 300 (the hub floor, H8 (a)).

oneOf.description: Fires every every_s seconds, measured from the record's last fire (from its creation before the first).
Fires once at at; the fire disables the record in the mint's transaction.

query.description: ReadEvents' typed filter (10-hub-request.json $defs/events_filter) with since as a window back from each poll and no until: structured fields only, never a query language (R37 H2 (a), H8 (a)).

every_s.description: How often the hub polls the count, in seconds, at least 300 (H8 (a)).

oneOf.description: The hub counts the events the query matches every every_s, through the same proxy function as ReadEvents with the own-event exclusion (C-10.23a), and the record's condition gates the fire.

field.description: What the condition reads: the events_count trigger's count. A chat's state from the hub index joins this enum by amendment once the index exists (10 section 5).

value.description: The integer the count is compared with.

condition.description: A gate the hub evaluates before any message reaches Home ('tell me only if it fails' is a gate, not a prompt). Required with an events_count trigger, refused with any other (the record's allOf; on an edit the hub checks it against the stored trigger).

kind.description: Where Home puts what the fire produces: its own page, a dashboard pane, a push notification, or nowhere (silence: Home acts on its own surfaces only if the instruction says so).

dashboard_id.description: The dashboard, for kind dashboard only, in 10-hub-request.json $defs/dashboard's dashboard_id form. The hub checks that it exists.

kind.description: Who authored the record: the user (a signed-in session or the user's key) or Home (svc_home).

id.description: The account: the user's usr_ id, or svc_home.

set_by.description: Stamped by the hub from the credential that created the record, never taken from a body (a body carrying it is bad_request). A fire's message is sent as this account with via scheduler (C-10.15).

label.description: The record's name on Today's Scheduled list, one line.

instruction.description: The text Home receives, verbatim, at most 3000 characters (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int lib/server/composer.js MESSAGE_MAX). The hub also refuses, as bad_request with field /record/instruction, an instruction whose composed section (C-10.14c: its heading line and count line beside it), with the line naming a hub_msg_id before it, would pass MESSAGE_MAX.

autonomy.description: notify: Home reports on its own surfaces; draft: any outward message Home writes for the check-in is held on Needs you under C-10.15's hold. 'Act' is the user's approval setting (C-10.23b), never the record.

zone.description: The user's zone for this record: the dry run's instants and Today's forecast are written in it. Defaults from the user's setting when the create gives none.

enabled.description: Whether the scheduler evaluates it. A user's record is enabled as created; a Home-authored record is created false and enabled only by the user's confirm (C-10.14c, R37 H11 (a)). Disabling keeps the record (there is no delete in round v1.5).

needs_confirm.description: Hub-set: true for a Home-authored record until the user's SetCheckIn {checkin_id, record: {enabled: true}} (the Needs you proposal card, I3-17) clears it.

created_at.description: When the hub stored it, RFC 3339.

updated_at.description: The last accepted SetCheckIn on it, RFC 3339.

last_fired_at.description: The last fire attempt, RFC 3339; null until the first. The scheduler arms the trigger from created_at, persisted at creation, so nothing fires at save time.

fires.description: How many fire attempts the record has spent.

next_fire_at.description: Hub-computed: the next fire or poll, RFC 3339; null while the record is disabled or spent.

allOf.description: A record waiting for the user's confirm is disabled: a Home-authored create, or a confirmed record Home re-edited (R43; 10 C-10.14c as A-10.4 writes it).

record.description: A stored check-in (C-10.14c). No brakes fields and no hub-wide ceiling exist (R37 H10 (b)): a later field joins by amendment (C-10.29 additive).

enabled.description: The user's switch. From svc_home it answers forbidden with need user (C-10.14c); on a Home-authored record the user's true is the second confirm.

record_input.description: The record less its hub-set fields (id, set_by, needs_confirm, created_at, updated_at, last_fired_at, fires, next_fire_at), as SetCheckIn takes it: a create gives label, trigger, instruction, destination and autonomy (10-hub-request.json $defs/params_SetCheckIn), an edit any of them, each replacing the stored field. A trigger given with a condition is checked here; a condition given alone is checked by the hub against the stored trigger, and an edit that gives a trigger other than events_count drops the stored condition.
